method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await key inflation report, Nvidia earnings
Equities.reason: Representative market-open tone: futures flat/little changed as investors sit on sidelines ahead of key inflation (PCE) and Nvidia — signals cautious/neutral risk sentiment for equities ahead of macro and mega-cap earnings.

Equities.title: US stock futures subdued in run-up to Nvidia results, inflation print
Equities.reason: Reuters piece reinforces a dominant market narrative of caution: subdued futures reflect risk management into two potential market-moving events (inflation data and Nvidia), increasing downside fragility if either disappoints.

Equities.title: Nvidia Earnings Give Investors a Barometer for State of AI Trade
Equities.reason: High-relevance thematic: Nvidia remains the focal point for the AI-led equity rally. Strong results would validate the AI leadership narrative and likely lift tech/market sentiment; this is a primary market driver.

Equities.title: Wall Street ends higher as tech rebounds before Nvidia results
Equities.reason: Shows the underlying positive skew from a tech-led rebound ahead of Nvidia — a near-term supportive force for equities even amid macro caution.

Equities.title: Nvidia’s dependence on hyperscalers faces big test in earnings report
Equities.summary: Nvidia is trying to expand its customer base by creating new financing options that allow for more clients to purchase its costly systems.
Equities.reason: Important idiosyncratic risk: concentration in hyperscalers is a vulnerability for Nvidia and, by extension, the AI trade; this tempers the upside case and increases downside risk if guidance weakens.

Equities.title: Stocks Drift and Treasuries Slip as Nvidia Looms: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market microstructure signal: drifting equity action and weaker Treasuries suggest positioning adjustments and rising short-term volatility risk ahead of Nvidia and inflation — marginally negative for equities.

Equities.title: Why today’s markets are not as contradictory as they seem
Equities.summary: What looks like a breakdown in historical correlations may simply reflect a different macroeconomic regime
Equities.reason: Macro/regime framing: provides context that unusual cross-asset moves reflect a new macro regime rather than contradiction — supportive of selective equity leadership (eg, AI) even as broader signals diverge.

Equities.title: Here's why markets are starting to care about the 2026 election 10 weeks out
Equities.summary: Wall Street analysts are tuning in 10 weeks ahead of the Nov. 3 election with concerns about risks to investors depending on how the U.S. results turn out.
Equities.reason: Political risk is creeping into market pricing; election uncertainty is a background tail-risk that could increase volatility and weigh on broad-risk appetite if it intensifies.

Rates.title: Bessent’s bond intervention puts US Treasury on collision course with Fed
Rates.summary: Increased purchases of debt threaten to undermine central bank chief Kevin Warsh’s bid to tame inflation
Rates.reason: Directly about large-scale Treasury purchases by the Treasury/administration — mechanically suppresses yields and can trigger market dislocations vs Fed policy. High relevance as it changes supply/demand balance in the core market.

Rates.title: Citadel Securities’ Flight Reverses Bearish Call on Long Bonds
Rates.reason: Reports a major dealer/flow change that reduces net short exposure in long-dated bonds — positioning-driven buying can pressure yields lower and amplify volatility in rates markets.

Rates.title: Stanley Druckenmiller leads doubters who think Bessent's bond ploys will fail
Rates.summary: The bond market interventions have generated a modest decline in yields along with a growing chorus of derision.
Rates.reason: High-profile skeptic view arguing intervention won't sustainably lower yields — relevant as a counter-signal but opinion-based and lower relevance to the broad rates regime.

Rates.title: US core PCE inflation expected to remain stubbornly high, urging the Fed to hike rates
Rates.summary: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) is expected to publish the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data for July on Wednesday, at 12:30 GMT.
Rates.reason: Explicitly flags sticky core inflation and the risk of Fed hikes — a primary macro driver that pushes yields higher (negative for bond prices) and is highly market-relevant.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary source on Fed policy intent and balance of risks; markets interpret them for hawkish/dovish tilt — here treated as likely to reinforce rate-hike/’higher for longer’ risks, increasing yields.

Rates.title: Trading Day: Oil, yields slide
Rates.reason: Headline notes a contemporaneous decline in yields — a direct market move that supports bond prices. Included as a near-term market-moving datapoint.

Rates.title: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all close higher as Treasury yields, oil prices retreat
Rates.reason: MarketWatch headline links equity gains to retreating Treasury yields — direct evidence of lower yields supporting risk assets. Lower relevance since it's a market colour piece rather than policy analysis.

Rates.title: Wall Street’s massive bet against long-term bonds is a recipe for a painful bearish unwind, says Citadel Securities
Rates.reason: Highlights concentrated short positioning in long bonds — a structural vulnerability that can produce sharp rallies (yield falls) if positions unwind, directly relevant to rates market risk.

Rates.title: China Banks Use Overnight Rate for Bonds as PBOC Reform Widens
Rates.reason: Covers Chinese onshore liquidity/operations — affects local bond-market functioning and global supply/liquidity considerations; moderate relevance to the rates narrative.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates hit highest level in 3 weeks, weakening demand further
Rates.summary: Mortgage rates rose again last week causing demand for both refinances and purchase loans to drop. Rates rose to their highest level in three weeks.
Rates.reason: Retail mortgage rate moves are a transmission of higher yield levels into consumer credit costs — supportive evidence of rising interest-rate backdrop and relevant to broader rates market.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on July 20 and July 29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on July 20 and July 29, 2026
Rates.reason: Official minutes from discount rate meetings provide insight into Board thinking on lending facilities/discount rate — carries policy signal that can raise/lower rate expectations; treated here as modestly hawkish for yields.

FX.title: US Dollar: Shaky basis trade risks weigh – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur explains how the US Treasury Secretary’s vague secondary sanctions comments and falling US yields have left the Dollar stabilizing but vulnerable.
FX.reason: USD-focused note highlighting basis-trade risks, policy/sanctions commentary and falling US yields — a clear vulnerability signal for the dollar. Moderately relevant to FX flows and near-term USD positioning ahead of PCE.

FX.title: US Dollar Index: Range-bound consolidation as PCE looms – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the US Dollar (USD) is firm, consolidating just above recent lows following the US Treasury buyback announcement.
FX.reason: BBH flags a firm but range-bound USD around Treasury buyback and ahead of PCE — a near-term USD-supportive but muted theme. Lower relevance because it’s consolidation/positioning rather than a fresh shock.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike expectations support JPY against US Dollar – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes the Japanese Yen is firmer versus most G10 currencies as markets increasingly price a Bank of Japan rate hike in September.
FX.reason: Central-bank repricing (BoJ hike in September) is a material FX driver. Market-wide expectation of tightening supports JPY broadly vs USD and other G10 — high relevance for FX regime shift.

FX.title: Euro: Schnabel’s upbeat tone supports against US Dollar – ING
FX.summary: Chris Turner at ING highlights that Eurozone data continue to surprise positively and ECB’s Isabel Schnabel now sees growth risks possibly to the upside.
FX.reason: ECB official’s upbeat comments plus positive data point to EUR resilience vs USD; relevant to EURUSD flows ahead of US inflation data.

FX.title: Australia’s Second-Largest Pension Makes Big Bet on Yen Strength
FX.reason: Large institutional flow into JPY is a concrete demand-side driver supporting yen strength; reinforces the BoJ-hike narrative and matters for FX positioning.

FX.title: New Delhi draws in $73 billion in 11 weeks, powered by special deposits for non-resident Indians
FX.summary: India has attracted inflows of $73 billion in 11 weeks, driven mostly by foreign currency bank deposits made by non-resident Indians.
FX.reason: Large FX inflows into India are supportive for the rupee and EMFX positioning (reduces funding stress, influences local rates and FX liquidity). Direct FX transmission and material flow size justify inclusion.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil drops below $80 amid hopes of Hormuz reopening, US-Iran de-escalation
Commodities.summary: Crude prices extend their reversal on Wednesday, with the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) trading at the $79.50 area as of writing, highlighting a 9% decline from last week’s highs above $87.00.
Commodities.reason: Clear oil downside driven by diplomatic progress (Iran-Oman) and reduced Strait of Hormuz risk premium. High relevance for WTI price action and broader energy market sentiment.

Commodities.title: Brent: Diplomatic progress weighs on prices – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC Bank strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that improved prospects for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and diplomatic developments involving Iran and Oman have eased supply concerns, pushing Brent crude below USD90/bbl.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note tying diplomatic progress to lower Brent risk premium — reinforces dominant market narrative of easing Middle East supply risk and pressure on oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil prices slide 2% on Iran-Oman talks to reopen Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Major wire confirms market-moving diplomatic developments materially reducing geopolitical premium — high relevance and a clear negative impulse for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Aramco offers more oil outside Hormuz with some cargoes heading to China
Commodities.reason: State seller expanding volumes and using alternative loadings lowers near-term tightness and supports the easing-of-risk-premium narrative for crude.

Commodities.title: Indian Refiners Widen Oil Search as Attacks Hurt Russian Flows
Commodities.reason: Counter-signal: disruptions to Russian flows and buyers widening search can tighten supply for regions and support prices. Included at lower relevance as it competes with stronger Hormuz-easing theme.

Commodities.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Fundamental supply growth from longer laterals increases U.S. crude and gas output over time — modestly bearish for prices and relevant to medium-term supply trajectory.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Higher inter-regional shipments relieve local shortages and ease product tightness on the West Coast — a modest bearish signal for refined product spreads and regional crude demand.

Commodities.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
Commodities.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, playing an increasing role in the international market for petroleum products at a time when supplies from other areas have been constrained.
Commodities.reason: Rising exports from a new large refinery increase product supply to global markets, a modest negative for regional product tightness and oil price upside.

Commodities.title: Copper Climbs From Record-High Close With Supply Still Tight
Commodities.reason: Supply tightness and fresh upside in copper is a clear bullish fundamental for the metal — high relevance for industrial metals and reflation/EM demand narratives.

Commodities.title: Gold slips ahead of US PCE as US Dollar firms modestly
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) edges lower on Wednesday as buyers trim their exposure ahead of the US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data, due at 12:30 GMT. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,615 after reaching $4,697 on Tuesday, its highest
Commodities.reason: Near-term gold vulnerability to firmer USD and upcoming US PCE (rate-path data). Market is in cautious stance ahead of macro print — typical medium relevance for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold little changed with US inflation data in spotlight
Commodities.reason: Wire note indicating muted gold moves as markets await US inflation — small negative tilt from USD/rate expectations but limited immediate impact.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $68.54 per troy ounce, down 0.16% from the $68.65 it cost on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Small intraday pullback in silver tied to metals' sensitivity to dollar/rate moves; low relevance technical/price update only.

Crypto.title: BlackRock cuts bitcoin ETF swap minimum to $1 million: Report
Crypto.reason: Lowering the swap minimum materially improves block-size and institutional trading flexibility for a major issuer, likely increasing ETF flows into bitcoin — large positive for BTC demand and crypto market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin takes a breather after adding 23% in 7 days as ETF demand holds steady
Crypto.reason: Continued strong ETF-driven inflows have pushed bitcoin sharply higher; the pause/consolidation is typical but overall momentum and flow-driven demand remain constructive for crypto prices.

Crypto.title: A massive $6.4 billion bitcoin options expiry on Friday could amplify volatility
Crypto.reason: A very large options expiry increases the risk of outsized intraday moves and gamma-driven volatility — a short-term negative for stability even if not a long-term demand signal.

Crypto.title: A bitcoin short squeeze for the ages as futures open interest collapses
Crypto.reason: Rapid short covering (OI collapse) explains part of the recent price spike — bullish for near-term prices but indicates rally may be partially momentum-driven rather than purely fundamental.

Crypto.title: Crypto greed gauge hits highest since just before October’s $19 billion wipeout
Crypto.reason: Sentiment measures at multi-month highs raise the risk of a mean-reversion event; this contrarian signal increases the probability of a significant pullback during frothy rallies.

Crypto.title: XRP’s 44% rally brings leverage back, raising risk of sharper pullback
Crypto.reason: Large altcoin rallies that reintroduce leverage increase systemic tail-risk in crypto markets; negative for short-term stability across altcoins and margin-sensitive venues.

Crypto.title: A 3% token move just triggered $36 million in Ethereum DeFi liquidations
Crypto.reason: Significant DeFi liquidations from a relatively small move underscore fragility in leveraged DeFi positions — raises tail-risk for ETH and on-chain credit markets.

Crypto.title: Zerohash back for second effort at OCC trust bank charter
Crypto.reason: Another crypto firm pursuing an OCC trust bank charter is a modest positive for institutional custody, regulatory clarity, and the build-out of bank-like crypto infrastructure.

Crypto.title: U.S. state banking associations plan to launch their own nationwide blockchain network
Crypto.reason: State banking groups building a blockchain network signals incumbents adopting tokenized rails — gradual positive for institutionalization and on-chain use cases.

Crypto.title: South Korea trade giant POSCO brings trade receivables to Avalanche in latest tokenization move
Crypto.reason: Corporate tokenization use-case from a major industrial firm is a small but constructive adoption signal for smart contract platforms and tokenized assets.

Crypto.title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
Crypto.reason: New trading infrastructure for crypto/tokenized markets improves market plumbing and execution — supportive for market depth and institutional participation over time.

Crypto.title: Chainalysis-run sting targets child exploitation networks with aid of Binance, Coinbase
Crypto.reason: Law-enforcement cooperation with major exchanges on criminal investigations is a modest positive for regulatory credibility and exchange legitimacy, reducing some compliance-related tail risks.
